highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.2 refreshes Skia m151 and co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102.
highlights_body: The co-shipping HarfBuzzSharp package adds Tag.Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char>) for parsing slices without substring allocations. The native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1.

bullets.detail: Refreshes the same-milestone native revision while preserving SkiaSharp's managed API, C API, and native dependency versions.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102 first publishes Tag.Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char>), avoiding substring allocations when parsing tags from a larger buffer. This is a package/API change; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1.

v4.151.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.2 refreshes Skia m151 and co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102.
v4.151.2.body: The co-shipping HarfBuzzSharp package adds span-based tag parsing; SkiaSharp's managed API is unchanged.
